description: Invented interface fixtures. These are not experiment results, robot recordings, or operational logs.

episodes.title: Arrange a green block
episodes.summary: An invented three-step example of moving a geometric block into a marked area.

steps.title: Inspect the illustration
steps.detail: The fictional scene contains one green block and one outlined target.

steps.title: Choose the target area
steps.detail: This example describes an intended placement. No physical action is performed.

steps.title: Mark the example complete
steps.detail: The completion label is fixture data used to demonstrate the interface.

episodes.title: Inspect a patterned tile
episodes.summary: A fictional inspection remains unresolved to demonstrate a review state.

steps.title: Read the example description
steps.detail: The imaginary tile has a pattern that this fixture deliberately leaves unspecified.

steps.title: Request a closer look
steps.detail: The example ends with a needs-review label. There is no captured observation behind this entry.

episodes.title: Group two shapes
episodes.summary: An invented sequence stops before the second shape is arranged.

steps.title: Identify two imaginary shapes
steps.detail: The example uses a circle and a square as a simple interface-writing exercise.

steps.title: Describe the first placement
steps.detail: Only one placement is described; the second is left unfinished in this fixture.

steps.title: Show the incomplete state
steps.detail: This label demonstrates presentation of an unfinished example, not a measured failure.
